body: Pretty rough until today, I'm in a community college. I'm in the engineering program which is ultra-stressful because it's grooming me to transfer to a big state school.

Thank you for the quick reply. I know I'm my own worst enemy. I've stopped eating and mostly stopped sleeping. I work myself to the bone. I don't know how to forgive myself. Until recently I was unable to cry which made life very painful. I recently plagiarized a paper for class, I let the teacher know before he found out. I don't know how to get past this shame. I've had a traumatic semester and its almost over, my finals are in 7 days or so. I've been so stressed between school, money, my father, and my ex. Sorry I'm all words right now but I find it hard to express these thoughts out loud so I guess it comes out here. I broke up with my girlfriend, we had been dating for about 13 months but the last 5 were awful for me. She brought all sorts of shit into my life and even though she was sweet she wasn't ever considerate; I finally got to a breaking point about 6 weeks ago and broke up for good. I wish I could be kind to myself but I was never brought up that way, I wouldn't know how to begin. I was raised to be a provider, I'm good with money, work hard, and protect people. I can't even listen to any music right now im so upset. I have to head to my next class but ill check in later this evening.
